name: python-plugin-monorepo
description: Generic Python-project profile (uv workspace): Python 3.11+, uv, pytest, ruff, no deployable web server, no frontend. Library or tooling repositories; each subdirectory under plugins/ may be its own pyproject.toml-managed package and shared/ holds cross-package scripts and profiles. Adopt gives it to any Python-only repository. Python repositories that are Claude Code plugins (a .claude-plugin folder) match claude-plugin instead. The name is historical.

folder_structure.plugins/: Per-SDLC-phase Claude Code plugins (each with .claude-plugin/, hooks/, skills/, scripts/, tests/, pyproject.toml)
